reviews.t:
Incredible small bakery, local atmosphere, reasonable prices and delicious baked goods!!!

My absolute favourite was the pain au chocolat (incredibly light and tasteful - the best I've ever had in Paris), but I also really liked the croissant, baguette and beignet.
However, the quiche (I tried spinach and vegetables) was too thick and heavy in my opinion, so I wouldn't recommend those. The staff was very friendly as well.

All in all, a really solid choice, mostly visited by locals and I absolutely don't understand the bad ratings at all!!!
Quand je passe rue Mouffetard, je fait toujours un détour pour les viennoiseries. Parmi les meilleurs de Paris.

Boulangerie pâtisserie que j'adore y passe lorsque je travaille y déguster c'est viennoiserie ou gâteaux que je trouve très bon accueil des vendeurs qui donne le sourire des le matin et c'est rare d'avoir des vendeur ou vendeuse qui soit toujours accueillant avec un tel sourire. Je trouve se qu'il propose en accord avec leur prix c'est un régale

Such a cute little place for a cafe creme or croissant! Their quiche was so very nice, and the pain chocolat brought me back for a second morning!

There are a couple of outdoor tables, and if you can snag one early in the day, you can watch the street come to life. The market spills onto the street and the crowds begin to come, and you'll watch it happen from this cute perch!
Les gérants sont super sympas et les produits très bon que ce soit les pains ou les viennoiseries !!
